# Architecture Index

This document defines the reading order for all KissJson architecture files. These documents describe the **current v1 contract** and should be read in order before implementation or release-hardening work begins.

## Reading Order

Read these files sequentially:

| # | File | Title |
|---|------|-------|
| 00 | [00-product-purpose.md](00-product-purpose.md) | Product Purpose |
| 01 | [01-public-api-contract.md](01-public-api-contract.md) | Public API Contract |
| 02 | [02-kiss-rules.md](02-kiss-rules.md) | KISS Rules |
| 03 | [03-core-architecture.md](03-core-architecture.md) | Core Architecture |
| 04 | [04-json-parser.md](04-json-parser.md) | JSON Parser |
| 05 | [05-json-writer.md](05-json-writer.md) | JSON Writer |
| 06 | [06-object-mapping.md](06-object-mapping.md) | Object Mapping |
| 07 | [07-configuration-model.md](07-configuration-model.md) | Configuration Model |
| 08 | [08-error-handling.md](08-error-handling.md) | Error Handling |
| 09 | [09-performance-strategy.md](09-performance-strategy.md) | Performance Strategy |
| 10 | [10-testing-strategy.md](10-testing-strategy.md) | Testing Strategy |
| 11 | [11-documentation-policy.md](11-documentation-policy.md) | Documentation Policy |
| 12 | [12-release-and-maven-central.md](12-release-and-maven-central.md) | Release and Maven Central |
| 13 | [13-github-pages.md](13-github-pages.md) | GitHub Pages |

## Status

All architecture documents describe the **current v1 contract** for `0.1.0`. Implementation and release-hardening work must follow these documents. If a document is ambiguous, clarify before implementing.
